name: Ritz Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas Resort
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas, a 400-acre resort in Las Colinas, formerly a Four Seasons resort, with a championship golf course and a spa
best_for: Golfers who want a resort with a championship course
Travelers who want a villa beside the resort pool

facts.text: The resort is set across 400 acres in the heart of Las Colinas.
The guest rooms were refreshed by the design firms Jeffrey Beers International and Leo A Daly.
The Dining Room at The Ritz-Carlton serves Italian-inspired cuisine, Texas steaks and seafood, and has a raw bar.
Aire Libre blends Texas flavors with Baja coastal cuisine.
Bar Juniper is in the hotel lobby.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa has a full-service hair and nail salon.
The spa has a cold plunge pool and a steam room.
The Villas overlook TPC Las Colinas.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite is the largest suite, in the tower, with views of Downtown Las Colinas, TPC Las Colinas and the resort pool.

highlights.text: A $55 million transformation of the resort, now managed by Ritz-Carlton, wrapped up in Spring 2024.
For more than 38 years the property was known as The Four Seasons Resort at Las Colinas.
The Poolside Villa has a terrace that opens directly into the resort pool.
TPC Las Colinas is an 18-hole, par-70 championship golf course.
Club level access is now an option, with a dedicated concierge and a lounge that has a view of the resort pool.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service from the airports.
WhataHotel notes the resort location may require transportation to downtown Dallas attractions.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing typical of Ritz-Carlton properties.
